stories.title: 13 passagiers van busongeluk in Zwitserland zijn terug in Nederland

en.title: 13 passengers from bus accident in Switzerland back in Netherlands
en.summary: Thirteen people involved in a bus accident in Switzerland on Thursday have returned to the Netherlands or are traveling back Sunday. Some passengers lacked travel documents as they remained in the bus.

stories.title: 'Geen aanwijzingen voor aanslag' bij ontsporing Franse trein

en.title: 'No evidence of attack' in French train derailment
en.summary: A prosecutor in Rouen stated there are no indications of sabotage in a train derailment in northern France that injured 44 people. The derailment was caused by a rail section on the tracks.

stories.title: Man overleden bij aanhouding in Rotterdam na melding over gestolen fatbike

en.title: Man dies during arrest in Rotterdam following stolen fatbike report
en.summary: A man became ill during his arrest in Rotterdam and could not be revived, according to police.

stories.title: Elena Rybakina verslaat titelverdedigster Aryna Sabalenka en wint voor het eerst US Open

en.title: Elena Rybakina defeats defending champion Aryna Sabalenka and wins US Open for first time
en.summary: Elena Rybakina won the US Open tennis championship by defeating defending champion Aryna Sabalenka in the final.

stories.title: Nieuwe nummer een van de wereld Elena Rybakina wint US Open

en.title: New world number one Elena Rybakina wins US Open
en.summary: Elena Rybakina won the US Open after also winning the Australian Open earlier in the year, defeating Aryna Sabalenka in the final.

stories.title: Rybakina wint als nieuwe nummer één ook in US Open-finale van Sabalenka

en.title: Rybakina wins US Open final against Sabalenka as new world number one
en.summary: Elena Rybakina defeated Aryna Sabalenka in the US Open final on Saturday. Rybakina had already secured the top world ranking before the match and successfully defended her position by winning the title.

stories.title: 13 passagiers busongeluk Zwitserland terug in Nederland

en.title: 13 passengers from Switzerland bus accident back in Netherlands
en.summary: Thirteen passengers from a bus that crashed in Switzerland on Thursday have returned to the Netherlands, with others set to return via various transportation methods. Eleven passengers remain hospitalized, including one in intensive care, with a support team assisting their recovery and return.

stories.title: Nog geen aanwijzing voor opzet bij ontspoorde trein in noorden van Frankrijk

en.title: No indication of intentional derailment of train in northern France
en.summary: Investigators have found no evidence suggesting the train derailment in northern France was deliberately caused.

stories.title: Man overleden bij aanhouding door politie in Rotterdam

en.title: Man dies during police arrest in Rotterdam
en.summary: A man died while being arrested by police in Rotterdam.

stories.title: Gouden Leeuw voor Deens oorlogsdrama ‘Woman Unknown’ op Filmfestival Venetië

en.title: Golden Lion for Danish war drama 'Woman Unknown' at Venice Film Festival
en.summary: The Danish film Woman Unknown won the Golden Lion for best film at the 83rd Venice Film Festival on Saturday. The jury prize went to Israeli documentary Naza, featuring military personnel and intelligence officers discussing the Gaza war.

stories.title: Feministisch Deens oorlogsdrama Woman Unknown grote winnaar op filmfestival Venetië

en.title: Feminist Danish war drama Woman Unknown major winner at Venice film festival
en.summary: A feminist Danish war drama titled Woman Unknown achieved significant victories at the Venice film festival.

stories.title: Teruglezen US Open | Rybakina wint finale na spannende driesetter tegen Sabalenka

en.title: Recap: US Open | Rybakina wins final after thrilling three-setter against Sabalenka
en.summary: Elena Rybakina won the US Open women's final against Aryna Sabalenka in a competitive three-set match.
